correction: The other-compute-provider requirement was an overgeneralization from standalone Depot CI to Depot GitHub Actions runners.

sourceChecks.finding: No macOS or Windows sandboxes in standalone Depot CI.
Nonstandard labels become Depot Ubuntu; native GitHub runner labels are not CI sandbox parity.
Windows Server 2022/2025 on Intel and macOS on Apple Silicon are documented GitHub runner offerings.

sourceChecks.section: How Depot GitHub Actions runners work
sourceChecks.finding: GitHub Actions orchestrates workflows while Depot registers and supplies the job runners.

originalTrialPlacement: Native macOS and Windows jobs used GitHub-hosted runners.
authorizedFollowUp: Execute the missing provider-specific native runner evaluation; preserve source cases and historical harnesses.
